DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's solution scales infinitely and enables organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide guaranteed performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases across different business units flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership, compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many Fortune 500 companies across the globe.
 Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!
 
 What You’ll Do 
 
• Build and enhance real-time anti-fraud systems processing large-scale data. 
• Develop and optimize backend services, internal tools, and validation frameworks. 
• Contribute to distributed system components across multi-region cloud environments. 
• Use big-data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, ClickHouse, Yugabyte) to build scalable pipelines. 
• Build real-time data workflows using Kafka, Flink, and related technologies. 
• Maintain development, testing, and delivery frameworks with a focus on quality and scalability.

• Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, OS, networking). 
• Proficiency in Java/Spring for backend development. 
• Experience with MySQL and SQL optimization. 
• Basic system design skills (scalability, reliability, performance). 
• Familiarity with testing, automation, and CI/CD. 
• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
• Experience with messaging systems (Kafka or similar). 
• Familiarity with analytical/distributed databases (ClickHouse, YugabyteDB). 
• Exposure to big-data frameworks (Spark, Flink). 
• Basic understanding of ML concepts and modern AI/LLM tools. 
• Experience with Kubernetes and cloud platforms (preferably AWS). 
• Ability to write automation scripts (Bash, Python).

• Hands-on experience in a dynamic and collaborative work environment. 
• Opportunity to work closely with experienced professionals in the field. 
• Exposure to real-world software testing scenarios. 
• Competitive hourly rate, range 20-25 CAD per hour.
fit_why: Backend Java/Spring and big-data stack; partial overlap with his Node/SQL work

jd:
Stage de janvier à avril 2027 

 Wolters Kluwer est un fournisseur mondial de solutions client innovatrices et intégrées qui soutiennent le flux de travail des comptables, des services de comptabilité et de fiscalité des sociétés et des auditeurs afin de favoriser leur croissance ainsi que l'augmentation de leur rendement et de leurs profits. Nos produits de recherche, qui incluent du contenu de qualité et des analyses d'experts, combinés à des logiciels performants, permettent à nos clients d'utiliser l'information efficacement.

Plus de 20 000 bureaux comptables, dont les 30 plus grands cabinets au Canada, s'en remettent à nos logiciels CCH iFirm Tax, Taxprep et Cantax , et les utilisent pour produire des millions de déclarations de revenus annuellement. 

 Vous participerez au développement et à l'évolution du principal logiciel d'impôt pour professionnels au Canada.

 Principales responsabilités : 
 
• Collaborer avec le spécialiste de l'expérience utilisateur (UX), l'analyste fonctionnel et le responsable de produit lors de l'élaboration des spécifications d'interface en effectuant les études de faisabilité technique requises. 
• Respecter et documenter les standards et meilleures pratiques de développement Web tout en assurant la compatibilité des éléments créés avec les navigateurs Web supportés. 
• Procéder au développement de solutions performantes, orientées utilisateur, réutilisables et pouvant être mises à l'échelle. 
• Contribuer au développement d'interfaces Web graphiques riches et dynamiques. 
• Effectuer les intégrations avec les API exposés de la plateforme et des applications tierces. 
• Effectuer les tests unitaires requis et corriger les défectuosités rapportées par l'équipe du contrôle de la qualité. 
• Faire appel à des techniques avancées pour analyser les problèmes et trouver des solutions et approches novatrices. 
• Participer à la recherche collaborative avec les architectes et programmeurs de solutions et de cadres d'applications adaptées au développement Web. 
 Environnement de travail: 
 Nous sommes : 
 - ... largement axé sur le travail d'équipe
- ... sur un horaire flexible de 35 h / semaine
- ... facilement accessibles par autobus de ville 
 - ... situés tout près de la piste cyclable et du Parc Jacques-Cartier
- ... de gros buveurs de café... il est gratuit en plus! 

 Exigences particulières: 
 Le candidat idéal possède les atouts suivants ou sera appelé à mettre en pratique les habiletés et compétences ci-dessous : 
 
• Expérience pertinente dans une équipe de développement d'applications Web modernes (p. ex., cadres d'applications angular.js, react.js, etc.). 
• Connaissance en conception d'applications Web réactives (JQuery, Bootstrap, MVC ou MVVM, modélisation de la partie client, etc.). 
• Développement ou réutilisation/intégration des nouvelles composantes UI. 
• Capacité d'adaptation rapide et d'exploration des nouvelles technologies. 
• Expérience en développement d'applications Web mettant l'accent sur la convivialité et l'expérience client (y compris des interfaces adaptatives). 
• Connaissance et maîtrise des normes et standards de création Web. 
• Expérience avec les processus de compilation (scripts) et de déploiement d'applications Web. 
• Connaissances relatives à l'utilisation et à la gestion de plusieurs dépôts Git. 
• Connaissance des bibliothèques de tests unitaires JavaScript. 
• Bilinguisme (français et anglais). 
 De plus, vous avez démontré, dans vos expériences de travail ou d'études précédentes, les habiletés suivantes : 
 
• Leadership et esprit analytique. 
• Excellente communication et approche interpersonnelle collaborative. 
• Bon sens de l'organisation et grande capacité d'adaptation. 
• Rigueur et ténacité dans la résolution des problèmes et souci du travail bien fait. 
 Our Interview Practices
 
 To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process. 
 
 Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

About the Company: 

 At SK Hynix Memory Solution,  we're at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, developing advanced memory solutions that power everything from smartphones to data centers. As a global leader in DRAM and NAND flash technologies, we drive the evolution of advancing mobile technology, empowering cloud computing, and pioneering future technologies. Our cutting-edge memory technologies are essential in today's most advanced electronic devices and IT infrastructure, enabling enhanced performance and user experiences across the digital landscape.

 We're looking for innovative minds to join our mission of shaping the future of technology. At SK Hynix Memory, you'll be part of a team that's pioneering breakthrough memory solutions while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. We're not just adapting to technological change – we're driving it, with significant investments in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and eco-friendly solutions and operational practices. As we continue to expand our market presence and push the boundaries of what's possible in semiconductor technology, we invite you to be part of our journey to creating the next generation of memory solutions that will define the future of computing.

 About the Role : As a software engineer intern at SKHMSA, you will be involved in the storage test software development and validation tests. The software design and development are based on the Industry standard specification and firmware internal algorithms.

 Internship Duration: 6 months 

 Hours: 40 hours per week 

 Start Date: January 2027 

 Location: San Jose 

 Responsibilities :

• Developing, coding, and debugging software tools using various programming languages and technologies, often focusing on areas C++, JavaScript, Python, etc. 

• Designing and implementing storage test tools tailored to specific needs, including software design, library, and user facing APIs. 

• Automating tasks and processes, such as build and deployment, test integration, and performance indicator generation. 

• Testing and validating the functionality, performance, and scalability of the developed tools 

• Creating and maintaining technical documentation for the developed tools, including user manuals, design documents, and release notes. 

• AI-assisted software development and documentation 

 Desired Skills and Experience: 

• Recently graduated or expected to graduate by December 2026 with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

• Proficient in software programming (C/C++, scripting languages like Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, node.js) 

• Data structures and algorithms, source control, databases, operating systems, networking basics, testing and debugging 

• Hands-on experience in debugging software 

• Good oral and written skills for communication and documentation. 

• Self-motivated, good team player, agile and quick learner 

 COMPENSATION: $35/hr - $45/hr
fit_why: Storage test tooling in C++/Python; partial fit, storage/firmware-adjacent domain

jd:
At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome. 
 Why This Role Matters 
 As an Intern Developer, you will join the team behind our internal test automation platform, a team at the heart of how Tecsys catches problems before they reach customers. You’ll build features across the platform’s React front end and Python services, write and maintain automated tests, and help keep CI/CD pipelines running on every merge request. Your work helps our developers ship with confidence, so the software hospitals and distributors rely on keeps working. 
 What You’ll Be Part Of  
 Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS). 
 Three values guide how we work . We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success. 
 You’ll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what’s possible. 
 What You’ll Do  
 
• Build and enhance features for our internal test automation platform, across the React front end and Python (Flask/FastAPI) backend services and APIs  
• Fix bugs and refactor existing code, writing pytest unit tests alongside your changes  
• Contribute to test-result reporting features such as dashboards, trends and run-to-run comparisons  
• Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Kiro) in daily development, reviewing and testing what they produce  
• Do first-pass code reviews on merge requests, and maintain CI/CD pipelines so automated tests run on every merge request  
• Build and maintain automated API, UI and unit regression tests, including turning Playwright recordings into stable, maintainable UI tests  
• Investigate failures, report defects with clear reproduction steps, and document features, test coverage and how to run the suites

What You Bring 
 You do not need to match every line below. If most of it describes you, apply: 
 
• Final year of a bachelor’s or master’s program in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field  
• Available for a placement of at least two terms  
• Solid knowledge of Python and React, with the ability to read and understand existing code  
• Experience with Git and merge/pull request workflows  
• Hands-on use of an AI coding assistant such as Claude Code, Kiro or Copilot  
• Good attention to detail and clear written communication  
• Previous co-op terms with other companies are an asset . 
 We foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. 
  If this role fits what you are looking for, apply today. If you are not actively searching but want to hear more, we are glad to talk  
 Apply today and discover what you could build, solve, and achieve with Tecsys! 
 #LI-TECSYS
fit_why: Python/React test automation platform, strong overlap with his stack

About the Role: 
 The Automation & AI Solutions Intern works directly with technology partners and business leaders to design, build and deploy automation and artificial intelligence solutions used in live deal workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivering production-ready tools that improve efficiency, decision-making and execution across the investment banking deal lifecycle. The intern will be embedded within Baird’s Global Investment Banking Technology Solutions team and will partner closely with deal teams and functional groups to identify manual, repetitive processes and translate them into scalable automation and AI-driven solutions.
  
 This is a hybrid internship, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday in our downtown Milwaukee, WI office and Monday and Friday remote. The intern must be able to work full time during the summer, 37.5-40 hours per week, and work part time during the school semesters, 15-20 hours per week. We are seeking a local student who can start in June 2027.
  
 The Impact You’ll Make: 
 
• Identify and automate manual processes across the Global Investment Banking deal lifecycle using Power Automate and Power Apps 
• Design and build end-to-end workflow solutions that integrate data from systems such as Salesforce, SQL, Snowflake, SharePoint and Excel 
• Prototype, test, and deliver AI-enabled use cases using tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, ChatGPT, Claude and Rogo 
• Build custom Copilot agents and AI-driven tools to support research, document synthesis, data extraction and decision support 
• Actively participate in discussions with business and technology stakeholders and present delivered solutions and outcomes 
• Produce clear technical documentation to ensure long-term maintainability and scalability of delivered solutions  
 What You’ll Bring to Baird: 
 
• Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems or a related field 
• Anticipated graduation date of May 2028 or later 
• Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python preferred) 
• Working knowledge of SQL and relational data concepts 
• Curiosity and enthusiasm for automation and artificial intelligence, with hands-on experimentation using tools such as Power Automate, Copilot, or large language models 
• Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders 
• Self-starter mindset with the ability to take ownership, prioritize effectively, and work independently in a fast-paced environment 
• Strong problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail  
• Comfort working collaboratively and in person with cross-functional teams  
 About Our Intern Program: 
 
• Jumpstart your career with Baird’s high-impact summer intern program! You’ll gain real-world experience, connect with inspiring leaders and grow through hands-on projects, mentorship and dynamic events.
